findings.issue: t_hunted_source.py is NOT present in the FILES arrays of deploy.sh, .github/workflows/deploy.yml, or .github/workflows/deploy_test.yml at the time of this validation. Task 13 assumes Task 6 has already added it and that Task 12 (pre-deploy QA) green-lit the deploy_files_invariant test. The transitive dependency chain (13→12→9/10/11→6) means Task 6 must complete before Task 13 is attempted. However, the deploy will silently fail to copy t_hunted_source.py to the server if Task 6 was skipped or partially executed — the deploy_test.yml Copy-files step would not error (it only errors if listed files are missing from the repo, not if they are absent from the list). The ImportError would only appear at the next cron tick on the server.
findings.fix: This is a pre-execution state issue, not a task authoring flaw — Task 6 must be completed and verified (via test_deploy_files_invariant.py) before Task 13 begins. The task body already documents this dependency correctly in the Details section. To make it harder to accidentally skip: add explicit depends_on: [6] to Task 13 frontmatter alongside [12], or confirm that the feature-execution orchestrator enforces transitive depends_on. No task file edit is strictly required if the orchestrator handles transitivity.

findings.issue: Task 13 writes its artifact to work/t-hunted-pt-source/logs/deploy/deploy-test.log, but the logs/deploy/ subdirectory does not exist in the repository and has no precedent in any other feature's work/ tree (only logs/qa/ exists in llm-transcreation feature). The task description marks the file as '(new)' but contains no mkdir instruction.
findings.fix: Add a step before writing the log: 'mkdir -p work/t-hunted-pt-source/logs/deploy'. Alternatively, note in the Details section that the directory must be created first. Most agents and write-tools will create parent dirs automatically, so this is low risk in practice.

findings.issue: Task 14 implementation hint (line 108) says to follow conventions from 'other logs/qa/*.json reports in work/completed/' — but no post-deploy-qa.json files exist anywhere in work/completed/ or any other completed feature. The prior-art pointer is empty.
findings.fix: Remove the 'if exists in work/completed/' qualifier from the hint, or point to the only existing qa artifact: work/llm-transcreation-and-distributed-publishing/logs/qa/pre-deploy-qa.md (which is a Markdown pre-deploy QA report, not a JSON post-deploy report — format differs). The fallback in the hint ('if not — design minimally') is sufficient; just drop the misleading forward reference.
